thread:
viv (SRE): quick follow-up to today's P95 surge on /generate during the maintenance window. postmortem draft in #incidents. we need owners for SLO change, dashboarding, and a recurring-incident threshold.

hana (Infra): root cause looks like concurrent cache flushes + autoscaler thrash. suggest a temporary p95 SLO relaxation from 210ms -> 275ms for 10 days to avoid alert storms while we patch.

elliot (ProdEng): okay to relax SLO if we get a firm mitigation plan. i'll own the mitigation RFC and patch (ETA 8 business days).

rade (SRE): i'll build the dashboards: p95 trends, autoscale step latencies, kv eviction rate, and error-budget burn. ETA 48h. i'll annotate last 5 incidents.

viv (SRE): hana will add an alert for kv eviction rate >4% over 5m (ETA 24h). ops-bot, please create a ticket for the SLO exception window.

ops-bot: created ticket SRE-2107 "/generate SLO exception + follow-ups" and linked to this thread.

hana (Infra): also planning a scale-down cooldown tweak; PR in 4d.

elliot (ProdEng): mitigation plan: increase cache TTL for hot keys, pre-warm new instances, and add admission control. will post RFC to SRE-2107 by EOD.

viv (SRE): decision log: 1) apply temporary p95 bump for 10d (approved). 2) dashboards + annotations (rade, 2d). 3) eviction alert + scale policy change (hana, 1-4d). 4) mitigation RFC + patch (elliot, 8d). 5) revert SLO after canary verification (viv).

rade (SRE): will push draft dashboard and ask for quick feedback.

viv (SRE): note recurring pattern: this is the fourth cache-related blip in 10 weeks. adding a runbook rule: >2 cache incidents in 30d -> escalate to hotfix-first.

ops-bot: reminder scheduled: check progress in 3 days for dashboard and alerting.

viv (SRE): keeping thread open. will post PR links and SRE-2107 updates here.
